caption: The drawing contains a detailed illustration of an ornamental, wrought-iron bracket or structural support element, primarily black and gray in color due to shading and line work on a beige or light tan background. The ornamentation features symmetrical, repeating patterns of stylized leaves, scrolls, and flowers. At the top center of the image is a horizontal section depicting a continuous pattern of symmetrical, curling leaves with fleur-de-lis-like points and central vertical elements. Below, the main composition is a T-shaped bracket, where both the horizontal and vertical parts are filled with intricate, curling vines, leaves, and floral motifs, bordered by straight edges. On the lower left, there is a smaller, lightly drawn schematic view of the bracket with measurements labeled, showing the same T-shaped outline and its relative proportions without detailed ornamentation. The signature "DESIGNED ERNEST TOWERS JR." is visible at the bottom right. The precise linework and shading emphasize the three-dimensional aspect of the floral and foliate forms throughout the drawing.
title: Iron Railing
